confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, and beer anchors use San Antonio aggregated cost-of-living prices updated 2026-10-15. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic estimates; cocktail and wine-glass values are estimated from their local price relationship to draft beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city used. Food and drink anchors use San Antonio-specific aggregate prices; accommodation uses broad mid-sized Texas and U.S. city norms.
